prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production game animation sprite atlas.
Input image 1 is the EXISTING CHARACTER IDENTITY reference; select ONLY ROW ONE: the white-furred biped wolf warrior with bone shoulder armour and clawed hands. Do not include other species.
Create one square transparent PNG sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 separate sequential full-body poses of this SAME character, left-to-right top-to-bottom. Frames 0–7 (first two rows) are an 8-frame seamless idle cycle; frames 8–15 (last two rows) are an 8-frame attack cycle. breathing and shifting shoulders subtly while feet planted; attack is anticipation, shoulder twist, claw swipe at frame 11, follow through then return.
CRITICAL: character identity, clothing, anatomy, weapons, colours, detailed painterly pre-rendered fantasy game style and fixed 3/4 right-facing camera must match reference. Genuine articulated limbs, no identical duplicate poses. SAME SCALE ALL SIXTEEN FRAMES, consistent contact point horizontally centered and ground baseline at 85% of each cell, 12% EMPTY PADDING on ALL cell edges. Entire wings, horns, tusks, bow and cloak must fit each cell. No grid lines, no text, no labels, no scenery, no drop shadow, no glow cloud, no magical projectiles or trails baked into sheet. Genuine transparent alpha background, not a checkerboard. Keep poses clearly separated. Do not redesign into a cartoon.
spacingCorrection: Edit target: supplied 4 by 4 sprite animation atlas. REPACK THE SAME SIXTEEN POSES into a new 4 columns by 4 rows square transparent sheet with MUCH MORE EMPTY SPACE. Keep precisely the same character, poses, sequential order, colours, equipment, full anatomy and painterly 3D shading. ONE uniform 65% scale factor applied to ALL sprites relative to existing layout. Each sprite centered in its own cell, foot contact at 80% cell height; each sprite must fit INSIDE the middle 65% of cell in both axes, even the extended weapon or spread wings. At least 15% transparent empty margin on ALL four sides of EACH cell. Do not crop body parts or effects. Background genuine transparent alpha. No text, labels, gridlines, shadows, borders or decorative elements. This is solely a spacing/layout correction to avoid adjacent animation frames touching.
